additional_discovery_reads: rg restricted to def execution_policy/decide and six decision labels in search/query_calibration.py and search/query_confidence.py, authorized by coordinating agent to ground the decision contract
method: Manual independent source-query interpretation; source spans generated by exact substring location and locally checked. Native operand values derive from explicit text and permitted backend semantics. No candidate imports, predictions or tests were executed.
native_field_policy: Only definite native scalar/list values are recorded. No fields project advisory, hypothetical, relationally conditional, missing or backend-unsupported requirements. Contradictory supplied numeric bounds are preserved for diagnosis, not authorization to execute. Native language strings retain source spelling; matches normalizes them.
decision_policy: Six decision types were available. Unsupported explicit relations are not reclassified as ambiguous merely because the backend lacks them. Semantic retrieval and optional preferences alone do not establish a notice requirement under the inspected active execution policy. The correction row records conditional notice uncertainty rather than inventing repair metadata.
limitations: This pilot is development evidence and is not fresh acceptance or a held-out independent acceptance set.
One LLM reviewer; no human review and actual runtime model identity not exposed.

Only the named packet, ontology and authorized active-backend slices were inspected; no catalog records, subject vocabulary, scope capability manifest, semantic retriever or ranking implementation was inspected.
No inference about retrieval quality, item availability truth or semantic preference satisfaction can be made without those uninspected components.
Decision-versus-notice metadata for the explicit correction query is not uniquely determined by the provided inputs; the row records this uncertainty.
Literal exact_text is a declared combined title/identifier field; strict title-only behavior under colliding identifiers is not established.
The title-only substring query is unsupported under the actual author-fallback matcher despite the declared title-domain mapping.
independence_statement: Annotations were authored without candidate predictions, candidate test outputs, author labels, historical gold or held-out queries. Coordination provided allowed paths, annotation schema and decision-contract references only.
